sources.note: Repo reached via the GitHub API as sst/opencode (redirects to anomalyco/opencode). stargazers_count 229638 and license MIT, read 2026-11-28. README read in full.
Rendered page read with a browser on 2026-11-28; the free-models and features panels are element captures of this page.

facts.claim: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent.
facts.verbatim_support: The open source AI coding agent.

facts.claim: The repo has over 229 thousand GitHub stars (229,638 on 2026-11-28).
It runs in the terminal and as a desktop app.
facts.verbatim_support: OpenCode is also available as a desktop application.

facts.claim: It comes with free models and no account is needed.
facts.verbatim_support: OpenCode comes with a set of free models. No account needed.

facts.claim: You can bring your own models; 200+ providers through Models.dev, including local models.
facts.verbatim_support: 200+ LLM providers through Models.dev, including local models

facts.claim: A ChatGPT Plus or Pro plan can be used instead of an OpenAI API key.
facts.verbatim_support: Use a ChatGPT Plus or Pro plan instead of an OpenAI API key.

facts.claim: It supports MCP servers, skills (SKILL.md) and custom agents.
facts.verbatim_support: MCP servers / Agent skills / Custom agents

facts.claim: Two built-in agents: build has full access, plan is read-only.
facts.verbatim_support: build - Default, full-access agent for development work; plan - Read-only agent for analysis and code exploration

facts.claim: Install with one command: curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/v2/install | bash.

assets.models-*.svg: Provider logos from the models.dev logo set used by opencode.ai.
